about.title: About Us
about.description: Founded in 1978, Papelsa is a leader in producing sustainable paper and corrugated cardboard boxes. Our commitment to quality, environmental care, and social responsibility drives innovation and customer satisfaction.

products.title: Our Products
products.description: We offer 100% recycled, recyclable, and responsible paper, sheets, and corrugated cardboard boxes tailored to your needs.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Our sustainability initiatives include recycling 81,000 tons in 2017, using 100% recycled fibers, and reducing energy and water consumption significantly.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: Reach out to our team for inquiries about our products, services, or sustainability efforts.
